# `apprafter unlock`

Open an unlock window in this terminal: for `--timeout` minutes, restarted by each command that uses it, commands started from this terminal use the target store's secrets without asking. Every process started from this terminal can use the window, an agent included; unlock in a terminal of its own, or end the window with `apprafter lock now`. Asks for the lock password or the recovery key even when a window is already open. (Not `apprafter backup unlock`, which clears stale backup-repository locks.)

```text
Usage: apprafter unlock [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Value | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--timeout` | `<MINUTES>` | — | no | Minutes the window stays open, restarted by each command that uses it. Defaults to the store's own setting: 5, or what `apprafter lock on --timeout` chose |

Examples:

```sh
apprafter unlock
apprafter unlock --timeout 30
```
